review_route.rationale: Independent falsification of a high-risk supported-host path boundary where sequential descriptor checks can be mistaken for one active namespace observation.

material_finding.summary: The reverse attachment chain is ordered leaf-to-root, but after the root-most descendant's final stat only the repository root is verified. An atomic swap in that interval lets read_file return descriptor-pinned original bytes while the active repository path contains foreign bytes.
source_evidence: validator/src/repository_fit/local/unix.rs:176-193 does not bind the root-most descendant

normal_production_reproduction.mechanism: LLDB stopped the non-cfg(test) binary at unix.rs line 119; macOS renameatx_np RENAME_SWAP atomically swapped repo/a with alternate before resuming

material_finding.deterministic_control: Depth-one and deep-path post-attachment swaps reproduced 2/2.
material_finding.contract_impact: Inspect, verify, apply preconditions and postconditions, and rollback reconciliation can consume detached bytes as current repository truth.

required_correction: establish one supported-host linearization point that binds the opened leaf or parent descriptor to the complete expected absolute path, root, and identity immediately before return
use an OS-backed whole-path descriptor primitive such as macOS F_GETPATH when supportable; fail closed when the host cannot prove the binding
retain exact leaf or parent descriptors until final binding and handle present and absent observations honestly
reject every swap before the final whole-path observation without following or accepting the substitute
state a finite linearization semantic and do not claim eternal or post-return namespace state
preserve descriptor anchoring O_NOFOLLOW exact names enumeration bounds special-file rejection and zero-write behavior without retries or assumed cooperative locks
